pages.text: Five flat stones lay across the stream. Red strawberries were ripe on the other side.
Mei wanted to pick strawberries too. Mei stood before the first stone.
Water rushed between the stones. Mei's feet wouldn't move.
Ppino hopped across. Rudi crossed too.
Soso and Leo crossed as well. Only Mei remained on this side.
The four picked strawberries. Mei touched a toe to the water, then pulled it back.
The four returned with lots of strawberries. Mei's hands were empty.
Grandma Bear tapped the first stone. "You don't have to cross all five at once."
Mei put a foot on the first stone. Two, three, four, five.
Mei picked a red strawberry. Soon, Mei's hands were full.
